Mohanlal film titled 'Operation Ganga' based on Ukraine evacuation

Malayalam actor Mohanlal's upcoming film, previously known by its working title L367, has been officially titled 'Operation Ganga'. The title is inspired by India's real-life evacuation mission from Ukraine. Mohanlal shared the first-look poster of the film on social media on September 4, 2026, revealing the new title. The film is directed by Vishnu Mohan.
